ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white/cream) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity (white) contiguous regions located on the distal portions of both lobes; low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central proximal region (peduncle attachment), median notch, and along the entire trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-degree angle of convergence and deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks is highest on the medial portions of both lobes, appearing as a series of jagged undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge sweep that curves outward to distinct, pointed distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular clusters (barnacles) localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes and the left leading edge; one isolated circular anomaly is visible in the lower-left white patch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated in the central black region and extending as dark scratches into the white distal patches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization on both distal tips; irregular, jagged edge profile on the extreme left tip suggesting prior tissue loss or heavy scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan pigmentation/staining visible across the interior of the white high-intensity regions on both lobes.
